structured.answer: I'd put the money I might need soon into a קרן כספית יומית: it shows 3.25% a year next to 0% in my עו"ש and 1.8% on a one-year deposit, and I can withdraw on any trading day. But I still don't know how much it costs, because the fees table has no numbers.

stuck.why: I was looking for how much it costs and only found fee names and 'אין תקרה בחוק', with no percent or shekel amount
Didn't understand whether the fund or the deposit comes out ahead on tax
Same 3.25% as the daily fund and I didn't understand the difference

used: Heading קרן כספית and subtitle 'סיכון נמוך שהלווה לא יחזיר'
Line 'כסף שצריך להישאר זמין: קרן חירום'
Comparison bars: עו"ש 0%, קרן כספית יומית 3.25% 'המוצג בעמוד', פיקדון לשנה 1.8%
'הוראת פדיון בכל יום מסחר' / 'בכל יום מסחר, במחיר של אותו יום'
unsure_meaning: Whether 3.25% is before or after fees ('לפני מס ועלויות'?)
Yellow vs. turquoise colour of the bars
not_found: Actual management fee in percent or shekels
Name of a specific fund or bank to buy from
A clear first step (which button / where to buy)
How much I could lose in the worst case

findings.what: Fees table has no amounts at all, only 'אין תקרה בחוק', so I don't know what it costs
No specific fund or familiar company is named, so I don't know what to buy
'אין ערבות של המדינה' and 'אין ביטוח' are scary with nothing saying how much I could lose
Lots of unexplained terms right in the first paragraphs (מק"מ, נאמן, השעה היעודה)
קרן כספית מתחדשת has the same 3.25% with no explanation of how it differs
The tax paragraph is long and the conclusion isn't clear
Codes like MF-11 / BANK-18 are scattered everywhere and add noise
